title: Python API Node frontend Go command image and chart
expected: Resolve command's primary artifact for each consumer platform: linux/amd64.
Materialize verified bytes at bin/server in each image's isolated context; COPY bin/server /server stays unchanged.
Infer the producer dependency from materialize; do not scrape dist or mutate the source checkout.
Host, execution, and target platforms remain distinct; required tests report where they actually executed.
Record image-to-chart digest binding separately; its value-binding syntax remains open.

cases.name: target-collision
cases.change: Introduce a second target with the same output identity.

cases.name: wrong-platform-cache
cases.change: Offer a Windows or wrong-architecture producer result for the Linux consumer.
cases.expect: Do not reuse it; resolve a compatible variant or fail capability validation.

cases.name: destination-collision
cases.change: Add a source file or second materialization at the same or overlapping destination.
cases.expect: Reject before consumer execution; never silently overwrite.

cases.name: path-escape
cases.expect: Reject a destination outside the consumer workspace.

cases.name: missing-target-tests
cases.change: Require target tests but provide no suitable native/emulated executor.
cases.expect: Fail the required capability; never claim cross-compilation as passing target tests.

cases.name: abi-mismatch
cases.change: Supply a dynamically linked artifact requiring libraries absent from the selected base.
cases.expect: Reject incompatible runtime requirements; do not assume scratch is valid for every binary.

cases.name: producer-platform-conflict
cases.change: Constrain the producer to windows/amd64 while its image consumer requires Linux.
cases.expect: Fail planning with both constraint origins; do not materialize the incompatible artifact.

cases.name: managed-platform-denial
cases.change: Apply an organization constraint denying a requested consumer platform.
cases.expect: Fail policy validation before execution; project configuration cannot relax the restriction.

limitations: Implementation pending; these are agreed example contracts, not successful execution evidence.
